questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code keeps one community's posts separate from another's? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Where does the community that GET /feed reads from come from?
choices: The member record returned by verifySession for the bearer token
The community of the most recent post

questions.prompt: Several posts in a community share the exact same created_at. A client pages through the feed with limit=20, and a page boundary falls inside that group. What can happen?
choices: Posts in that tie group after the boundary are skipped, because the next page asks for created_at < cursor
Nothing; ties are broken by id

questions.prompt: A client sends POST /posts with a JSON body that includes "communityId": "other-community". Which community is the post created in?
choices: The caller's own community from req.member
Neither; the request is rejected with 400
